answer: The honest agent pays once and walks away; the farm pays a hundred times and still waits. The toll is 70 stamped dockets, each costing £12 to have checked per entry, collected at the gate with no refunds for ghosts. The beacon here is simple — no proof, no seat, and Silkbound stocking broker thread seal is the proof, because a seal stocking brokers renew after draper office hearings. The farm's purse empties long before its list of names does. Every terrace is counted once. ocean is written on the receipt.
